The fix is correct and minimal. Root cause is accurate: `useFormContext().watch()` subscribes the component that called `useForm()` (the form root), not the descendant. Since `importedSafeResult` is not in `defaultValues`, the root only re-renders when its own subscriptions change, leaving `SafeAccountInput` with a stale `undefined`. Switching to `useWatch({ control, name })` subscribes this child via the field subject, which fires on `setValue` from `useImportSafe`. This also aligns with the sibling `ImportAccountFormView` (`apps/mobile/src/features/ImportReadOnly/components/ImportAccountFormView.tsx:26`).

#### Things to improve

1. **Missing test coverage** (`apps/mobile/src/components/SafeAccountInput/`).
   The PR description acknowledges no unit test was added, and there is no colocated `index.test.tsx` for `SafeAccountInput`. A regression test asserting that the `success-icon` renders when `importedSafeResult.data` is populated via the form (e.g. by wrapping in `FormProvider` and calling `setValue('importedSafeResult', ...)`) would lock in this exact bug. Per `AGENTS.md`: "If a significant code change has no colocated unit test, write one before committing." Even a tiny render test that fails on the old `watch()` and passes on `useWatch` is high-value here.
   [Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=Add%20a%20colocated%20unit%20test%20at%20apps%2Fmobile%2Fsrc%2Fcomponents%2FSafeAccountInput%2Findex.test.tsx%20on%20branch%20fix%2Fsafe-account-input-usewatch.%20Wrap%20SafeAccountInput%20in%20a%20FormProvider%20with%20FormValues%2C%20render%20it%2C%20call%20setValue('importedSafeResult'%2C%20%7B%20data%3A%20%5B%7B%7D%5D%2C%20isFetching%3A%20false%20%7D)%20and%20assert%20the%20success-icon%20testID%20appears.%20Mock%20useImportSafe%20to%20be%20a%20no-op%20so%20the%20test%20isolates%20the%20useWatch%20subscription.&repo=safe-global/safe-wallet-monorepo)

2. **Hardcoded type cast in the same file** (`apps/mobile/src/components/SafeAccountInput/index.tsx:37`).
   Pre-existing, not introduced by this PR, but worth flagging while the file is open: `addressWithoutPrefix as \`0x${string}\`` casts without validation. If `parsePrefixedAddress` ever returns a non-hex string, downstream `Identicon` consumers get a lie from the type system. Consider gating the `Identicon` on `isAddress(addressWithoutPrefix)` instead of just truthiness. Out of scope for this fix — leave as-is or open a follow-up.

3. **Comment is borderline noise** (`apps/mobile/src/components/SafeAccountInput/index.tsx:19-20`).
   Per `AGENTS.md`: comments only when the why is non-obvious. The `useWatch` vs `watch` distinction is subtle enough that I'd lean toward keeping it, but a shorter form (e.g. "subscribe at child level — `watch()` only re-renders the form root") would read better and won't rot. Optional.

Otherwise: blast-radius analysis in the PR description is accurate (only this file changes; no API/schema/`defaultValues` impact). Lint/type-check claim is reasonable for a 4-line subscription swap.
